articles.title: Over One Hundred Detained in Delhi During Election Commission Protest
articles.summary: More than one hundred people were detained in New Delhi during a protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over electoral roll revisions. Demonstrators raised concerns regarding new voter registration requirements. The Supreme Court is currently examining legal challenges involving the Election Commission and police responses, while political figures and student leaders have joined the ongoing movement.

articles.title: Bangladesh Government Ensures Peaceful Durga Puja For Hindu Minority
articles.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman deployed thousands of security personnel across Bangladesh to safeguard Durga Puja celebrations. The government extended public holidays and increased financial assistance to protect minority communities from violence. Although a temple arson attempt occurred in Gazipur, swift police intervention prevented wider clashes. Hindus expressed relief over the peaceful festivities while continuing to demand lasting justice and accountability.

articles.title: India Faces Solar Supply Risks as China Proposes Technology Export Curbs, Solex Seeks

articles.title: PM Modi Highlights Punjab’s ‘Nav Trinjan’ Initiative to Promote Organic Cotton
articles.summary: Speaking during the 139th episode of his monthly radio programme ‘Mann Ki Baat’, the Prime Minister said India’s traditional skills were being adapted to contemporary needs, creating opportunities to preserve cultural heritage while supporting livelihoods. The initiative is being implemented by the Kheti Virasat Mission, which has been working to revive organic farming and traditional agricultural practices.

articles.title: Farooq Abdullah criticized over remarks on Pakistan and Kashmir
articles.summary: Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Farooq Abdullah faced criticism for remarks suggesting Pakistan is helping keep the region's unresolved status alive internationally. Critics argued his comments undermined local interests and ignored Pakistan's history of sponsoring terrorism. The remarks could potentially hinder efforts to restore statehood to the Union Territory.

articles.title: Indian Railways Launches Specialised Salt Container Train In Gujarat
articles.summary: Indian Railways has launched a specialised salt container train between Shivlakha Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal in Kutch and Mithapur, Gujarat. articles.title: We deeply apologise: Organisers break silence after Shilpa Rao's set is cut short
articles.summary: The organisers of the Bollywood Music Project (BMP) have apologised after singer Shilpa Rao’s performance at the festival’s 10th anniversary edition in Mumbai was abruptly cut short on October 24. articles.title: MCA extends company filing deadlines for FY26; financial statements due by December 31
articles.summary: Under the revised schedule, companies can file financial statements through various versions of Form AOC-4, including consolidated financial statements, XBRL-format filings and applicable forms for non-banking financial companies, by December 31, 2026, without additional fees. articles.summary: Ramayana has collected ₹ 11. 38 crore through advance bookings across its first three days in India. Films Discourse reported these figures on 25 October at 5:43 AM. articles.title: Global Youth Protests Expose Deepening Economic Discontent Worldwide
articles.summary: Young people across Asia and Europe are staging widespread protests over high unemployment, expensive housing, and broken economic expectations. Frustrated by declining social mobility and the visible display of concentrated wealth, these decentralized movements highlight growing doubts about modern capitalism. Governments worldwide face mounting pressure to renew the social contract and address deepening economic insecurity among citizens.

articles.title: ‘Immense Pride and Joy’: PM Modi Hails India’s Record 114 Medals at Asian Para
articles.summary: India’s para-athletes finished the Asian Para Games 2026 with a record 114 medals, prompting Prime Minister Narendra Modi to hail an achievement he described as an occasion of “immense pride and joy” for the country. articles.title: Tamil Nadu Employment Department warns staff against approaching ministers for transfers

articles.title: 21-year-old killed by mother’s partner in Hussaini Alam
articles.summary: Hyderabad: A 21-year-old man died after allegedly being attacked with a knife by his mother’s partner on Saturday, October 24, within the limits of Hussaini Alam Police Station. The deceased has been identified as Madhur Singh. He had allegedly confronted his mother’s partner, Bhagat Singh, over their relationship, which led to the attack, said the Hussaini Alam police.

articles.summary: Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament Kapil Sibal has criticized Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh chief Mohan Bhagwat regarding recent regime change remarks. articles.title: MHA seeks stakeholder feedback on pan-India emergency communication network
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has invited public and stakeholder feedback on the proposed architecture of a dedicated pan-India Broadband Public Protection and Disaster Relief (BB-PPDR) communication network designed to ensure reliable, secure and uninterrupted communication among police forces and emergency response agencies, particularly during situations arising out of disasters and network congestion.

articles.title: Actor Naseeruddin Shah Backs Protesting Kolkata Film Institute Students
articles.summary: Actor Naseeruddin Shah criticized the Bharatiya Janata Party on Saturday for targeting Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute students in Kolkata. The students have staged an indefinite sit-in since October twelve following campus violence and administrative issues. Shah accused the political party of taking revenge on critics. The institute suspended academic operations and ordered students to leave the campus.

articles.title: Trump again claims credit for halting India-Pak war at midterm poll rally; rues Nobel
